name: Fran
description: 21-15-9 thrusters (43/29 kg) and pull-ups for time. Log RX time to Maxes → Benchmarks.

name: Cindy
description: AMRAP 20 min: 5 pull-ups, 10 push-ups, 15 air squats. Log rounds+reps to Maxes → Benchmarks.

name: Murph
description: 1 mile run, 100 pull-ups, 200 push-ups, 300 air squats, 1 mile run (20 lb vest optional). Log total time to Maxes → Benchmarks.

name: Helen
description: 3 rounds for time: 400 m run, 21 KB swings (24/16 kg), 12 pull-ups. Log time to Maxes → Benchmarks.

name: Plate Neck Flexion
description: Supine on a bench, head off the end, light plate on a towel on the forehead; nod chin to chest. Prehab for collision sports.

name: Prone Neck Extension
description: Prone on a bench, head off the end, light plate / harness behind the head; extend to neutral, no further.

name: Manual Neck Isometrics
description: Hand on forehead / back / side of head; push into the hand and hold without moving. Front, back, left, right.

name: Band Neck Lateral Flexion
description: Band anchored at head height around the side of the head; tilt ear toward shoulder against the band.

name: Heel Walk
description: Walk on heels with toes pulled up — tibialis anterior endurance for shin-splint resilience.

name: Banded Ankle Dorsiflexion
description: Seated, band anchored in front around the top of the foot; pull toes toward the shin.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
description: Wide stance, toes out, single dumbbell held between the legs — adductor-biased squat.

name: Side-Lying Adductor Raise
description: Lie on your side, top leg crossed in front; raise the bottom leg with the inner thigh.

name: Rear Delt Row
description: Chest-supported or bent-over row with elbows flared ~70°, pulling toward the upper chest.

name: Neck Harness Extension
description: Seated or standing hinged slightly forward, light plate on a head harness; extend the neck from a slight nod back to neutral.
cues: Move only the neck, not the torso
Stop at neutral, never crank back

name: Chin Tuck Hold
description: Lying on your back, nod the chin and lift the head a finger-width off the floor; hold. Trains the deep neck flexors.
cues: Tongue on the roof of the mouth
Stop if the chin pokes forward

name: Tib Bar Raise
description: Seated on a box with a tib bar (or loaded strap) over the forefoot; pull the toes up toward the shins, lower slowly.

name: Seated Kettlebell Tib Raise
description: Sit on a bench edge, kettlebell handle (or plate) hooked over the toes of one foot; raise the toes, lower under control.

name: Wall Tib Iso Hold
description: Back against a wall, feet out in front; pull the toes up as high as possible and hold.

name: Band Rear Delt Fly
description: Band anchored at chest height; straight-arm reverse fly to a T.
